Lake Tõhela (Estonian: Tõhela järv) is a lake in southwestern Estonia. It is located in the village of Männikuste in the urban municipality of Pärnu, Pärnu County.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 320.4 hectares (792 acres), and it has five islands with a combined area of 2.4 hectares (5.9 acres). The lake has an average depth of 1.0 meter (3 ft 3 in) and a maximum depth of 1.9 meters (6 ft 3 in). It is 2,760 meters (9,060 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 14,690 meters (48,200 ft). It has a volume of 3,114,000 cubic meters (110,000,000 cu ft).
